name: muggle
description: The release discipline of 13 years shipping hyperscale web products at Microsoft, built into your AI coding agent. Freezes requirements, builds, drives a real browser through end-to-end (E2E) acceptance tests on signup, checkout, and dashboards, opens the PR with screenshots, then watches reviews and CI until it's mergeable. Plain-English tests replay on localhost as regressions. Works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Windsurf.
